plan.coverage_notes: The plan covers therapeutic modalities (CBT, IPT-A, mindfulness, family, digital), pharmacotherapy, assessment/safety, contextual factors (social media, schools), and evidence synthesis (RCTs, meta-analyses, implementation). It deliberately excludes neuroimaging, biomarkers, and pure developmental neuroscience as per the profile. The assumption is the clinician needs actionable clinical research, not mechanistic studies, hence the focus on interventions, tools, and real-world application.
